commands: e=`ipfw table 1 add <ip> 2>&1`; x=$?; [ $x -eq 0 -o "$e" = 'ipfw: setsockopt(IP_FW_TABLE_XADD): File exists' ] || echo "$e" | grep -q "record already exists" || { echo "$e" 1>&2; exit $x; }
e=`ipfw table 1 delete <ip> 2>&1`; x=$?; [ $x -eq 0 -o "$e" = 'ipfw: setsockopt(IP_FW_TABLE_XDEL): No such process' ] || echo "$e" | grep -q "record not found" || { echo "$e" 1>&2; exit $x; }

files.jail.local:
[o-a-bsd-ipfw]
enabled = true
filter =
logpath = /dev/null
backend = polling
action = bsd-ipfw

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING No filter set for jail o-a-bsd-ipfw
